label: clear-minor-past
text: On Monday I walk to work because the buses were late.

result.summary: 说话者在周一步行去上班，原因是公交车晚点了。

label: clear-article
text: Could you pass me pencil on the table?

result.summary: 说话人请求听者把桌上的铅笔递给自己。

issues.explanation: 如果你想表达桌上特定的那支铅笔，需要加上定冠词以明确指代对象。

label: unclear-reference-new
text: Lena emailed Nora after she changed her appointment.

result.summary: Lena在Nora（或Lena自己）更改预约后发了邮件。

issues.explanation: 如果你想表达是Lena更改了预约，原句中的'she'指代不明，因为前文出现了Lena和Nora两个人物，无法确定'she'是指Lena还是Nora。将'she'改为'Lena'可以消除歧义。

alternatives.explanation: 如果你想表达是Nora更改了预约，原句中的'she'指代不明。将'she'改为'Nora'可以明确动作的执行者。

label: contradictory-date-new
text: I will arrive next Tuesday, which was three days ago.

result.summary: 说话者计划在下周二到达，但指出该日期在逻辑上对应过去的三天前。

issues.original: I will arrive next Tuesday, which was three days ago.
issues.explanation: 如果你想表达动作已经发生且发生在过去，原句中的 'will' (将来时) 与 'was' (过去时间) 矛盾。请确认你是否想表达‘我三天前已经到了’？如果是，建议改为过去时态并删除对日期的模糊指代。

label: transfer-direction-new
text: Could you borrow me your umbrella until tonight?

result.summary: 说话人请求借用对方的雨伞直到今晚。

issues.explanation: 如果你想表达向对方借东西，英语中应使用 lend sb sth（借给某人某物），而 borrow 表示从别人那里借入，不能直接接双宾语。

alternatives.original: Could you borrow me your umbrella until tonight?
alternatives.improved: Can I borrow your umbrella until tonight?
alternatives.explanation: 原话并非错误，只是用词不当。如果你想表达自己借伞，也可以直接用 Can I borrow... 来提问。

label: two-problems-preserve-speaker
text: I will return yesterday. Can you borrow me your bicycle?

result.summary: 说话人声称将在过去的时间（昨天）返回，并请求借给自行车。

issues.explanation: 如果你想表达动作发生在过去，'will' 与 'yesterday' 矛盾，应改为过去式。

issues.original: Can you borrow me your bicycle?
issues.improved: Can you lend me your bicycle?
issues.explanation: borrow 意为‘借入’，lend 意为‘借出’。你是想向对方借车（让对方借给你），所以应用 lend。
